_comment: Issue #59 (the dish-item seam): the Serve option now compound-gates on {once_per_waking, item} -- the FOURTH sanctioned compound requires (test_content.gd's _validate_requires), alongside {gold,accomplishment}/{accomplishment,once_per_waking}/{accomplishment,class}. GATING SPLIT (wi-adding-dialogue-and-quests convention): item possession is an in-conversation-ACTIONABLE thing (go cook, come back) -- NOT progress-gated (dialogue.gd's _progress_gated deliberately omits `item`), so an empty-handed visit stays VISIBLE-LOCKED naming the missing dish ('requires Hot Meal'), never hidden; once_per_waking IS progress-gated (the vanishing-tease precedent), so after a successful serve the option disappears entirely from the list REGARDLESS of whether a fresh dish is in hand -- cook a second meal same waking and the option still doesn't reappear until sleep clears entity_first_use. dialogue.gd's _meets() ANDs both legs for the actual lock/choose decision; _meets_progress() reads ONLY the once_per_waking leg for hide-until-met visibility (item never controls hiding, only greying) -- exactly the same split the {accomplishment,once_per_waking} compound already established, just with `item` standing in for `accomplishment`. The serve CONSUMES the dish via the new `remove_item` effect arm (WIGame.dialogue_choose) -- the sim's one inventory-removal seam (remove_item(), the delivery-board parcel-handoff precedent) applied to a second consumer. See qa/scripts/work_loop.json for the full fetch/lock/consume/once_per_waking-survives-a-second-cook/post-sleep-available proof.

options.text: Bring her a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

served.text: Ahh. Now THAT'S service. I'll want another before long, mind.
